deadline_audit.action_time_method: GameRun.started_at plus cumulative ActionRecord.wallclock_seconds; UTC alignment, not an instrumented action-start boundary.
deadline_audit.evidence_boundary: The 256-event deadline deque intentionally evicts old passed checks. Aggregate counts survive; full no-new-client-request evidence comes from lossless inference-timing. Client admission does not guarantee server arrival before deadline or abort in-flight work.

scheduler_audit.scope: Validates observed decisions and attribution; does not treat a changed ordering on a different trajectory as a causal score replay.
